# Fenel

> Fenel is a programming language, a runtime and a web app built on the idea
> that types = UI = app: a type describes data, and the form that edits it, the
> rules that check it and the way it is shown come from that type. The public
> demos at https://usefenel.com run entirely in the visitor's browser. No
> account is needed.

Checked against the repository on November 12, 2026. Fenel is early,
experimental software; the site can differ from this summary.

Its author describes it as "Codex-Data: unifying software from programming to
the application". Functions, types and records are all data that a person can
open, read and change. Types are values at runtime, and a type is a set of
values: a refined type carries its own rule (a demo password type begins
`HintPassword = String | length value >= 8 && containsAnUppercaseLetter value && …`),
and the interface shows each part of such a rule as a live hint while the
visitor types.

The language is functional: algebraic data types, pattern matching, lambdas,
currying, partial application, typeclasses and do-notation. Source files end in
`.fenel`. The engine (type checker, evaluator, standard library) is written
in good part in Fenel itself; the reference runtime is written in TypeScript; the web app is
called Narthex.

The solver and the claim demos keep an undecided answer apart from a negative
one: an unsupported equation is answered "Undecided", not "no solution".

**Status.** At launch, accounts and server features are not open, and "Log in"
is not active. "Local" is a personal area where a visitor makes their own types,
data and functions; it is kept in that browser only (not synced, not backed up).
"Edit in Local" copies some demos there. The first visit downloads a large
engine and takes a while. The public repository holds the source (language,
engine, reference runtime and app) under the Apache License 2.0. Copyright
Romain Leclercq.

## Linking to data

- Every demo item has an address `https://usefenel.com/demo/<collection>/<item>`,
  using the collection and item names exactly as shown on the page,
  percent-encoded (a space is `%20`). A collection alone is `/demo/<collection>`.
  The unfinished demos sit one level deeper, under `/demo/Unfinished%20demos/`.
- [All demos](https://usefenel.com/demo): the finished demo collections, then the unfinished demos.
- [Standard library](https://usefenel.com/std): the built-in functions and types.
- [Home](https://usefenel.com/): the public data and Local.

## Demos

- [People and projects](https://usefenel.com/demo/People%20and%20projects/Fenel): people, projects and a mascot as linked typed data, including Fenel's own record.
- [Recipe functions](https://usefenel.com/demo/Recipe%20functions/Sports%20formula): two recipes written as pure functions, the "Moisturizing-lubrication formula" and the "Sports formula", with facts derived from their bodies. Supplied examples; no health claim.
- [Solver](https://usefenel.com/demo/Solver/Solve%20an%20equation): exact linear equations, finite searches, train routes and meeting slots, and honest "Undecided" answers ([an unsupported equation](https://usefenel.com/demo/Solver/An%20unsupported%20equation)).
- [Tree of life](https://usefenel.com/demo/Tree%20of%20life/Tree%20of%20life): kingdoms, classes, families and species as nested sets, and the foods they give.
- [Living things](https://usefenel.com/demo/Living%20things/Fennels): plant families, genera and species as sets, including the fennels.
- [Countries of the world](https://usefenel.com/demo/Countries%20of%20the%20world): country data, filtered by currency.
- [Greek alphabet](https://usefenel.com/demo/Greek%20alphabet/Greek%20alphabet): the modern Greek letters as sets you can combine and check text against.
- [Writing systems](https://usefenel.com/demo/Writing%20systems): Latin, Russian, Elder Futhark runes, hiragana and katakana.
- [Programming languages](https://usefenel.com/demo/Programming%20languages/Programming%20languages): ten languages Fenel learns from.
- [Input checking](https://usefenel.com/demo/Input%20checking/Sign%20up%20with%20live%20hints): a sign-up form whose email, website, password and age rules show as live hints.
- [Drawing](https://usefenel.com/demo/Drawing/Square%20formula): a function of x drawn as a curve, and composed shapes.

## Unfinished demos

Earlier demos that have not been reworked yet. They may be rough.

- [Unfinished demos](https://usefenel.com/demo/Unfinished%20demos): the list.
- [Types and forms](https://usefenel.com/demo/Unfinished%20demos/Types%20and%20forms): change a type and see the generated input change.
- [Images](https://usefenel.com/demo/Unfinished%20demos/Images): pixel data, filters and a photo editing chain.
- [Languages](https://usefenel.com/demo/Unfinished%20demos/Languages): one value shown in two reader languages.
- [Statistics](https://usefenel.com/demo/Unfinished%20demos/Statistics): summaries, customer totals and charts.
- [Data import](https://usefenel.com/demo/Unfinished%20demos/Data%20import): CSV, JSON, regular expressions and Lisp read into typed data.
- [Animation](https://usefenel.com/demo/Unfinished%20demos/Animation): the drawing moved by a time formula.
- [Recipes and rules](https://usefenel.com/demo/Unfinished%20demos/Recipes%20and%20rules): plan recipes from a catalogue under rules, with each rule's reasons.
- [Documents](https://usefenel.com/demo/Unfinished%20demos/Documents): a typed document exported to Markdown or HTML and read back.
- [Named claims](https://usefenel.com/demo/Unfinished%20demos/Named%20claims): claims with a kernel verdict, sample evidence or an undecided answer.
- [Axioms](https://usefenel.com/demo/Unfinished%20demos/Axioms): seven families of Fenel's foundations as data with editable examples.
- [Text tools](https://usefenel.com/demo/Unfinished%20demos/Text%20tools), [Date tools](https://usefenel.com/demo/Unfinished%20demos/Date%20tools), [Unit tools](https://usefenel.com/demo/Unfinished%20demos/Unit%20tools): small utilities as ordinary functions.
